connector.name: Cds Db Nlquery MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for natural-language queries against SAP CAP db-layer entities via real CQN/SQL JOINs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cds-db-nlquery-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the shahidla account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key (used if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set and OPENAI_API_KEY is not)

env.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ENTITIES
env.description: Comma-separated entity allowlist, enforced on JOINs too

env.name: MCP_BLOCKED_COLUMNS
env.description: Comma-separated column blocklist, stripped before the query is built
